recommendations.criterion: 原处理人转出任务、归档通知并重新打开客户端后，仍能从个人工作台找到自己有协作权限的本单并查看记录，无需加入整个来源工作空间；该单不再计入其当前处理待办。已退出或被移除的账号不能继续凭旧协作身份使用这一入口。

clauses.clause: Transfer responsibility away, archive its original transfer notice, close/reopen a client and perform a fresh password login.
Find the same private records from participating workbench while current handling has zero items, with no source workspace membership.
Removed or departed participant cannot reuse the old collaboration entry.
clauses.scope: Public removal in both actual clients; voluntary exit/current revoked-participant predicate at canonical backend.

recommendations.criterion: 有权者向离线的新账号邀请/派单，提交成功即加入；派单时责任和待办同时转移，接收人登录后直接可见，无待接受步骤。仅邀请不改变当前处理人；无权或目标失效时不部分生效，重放请求不重复交接。接收人的个人运行环境仍须本人按单授权。

clauses.clause: Authorized new-account invite/assignment while client is closed immediately commits participation/responsibility/workbench; fresh login opens without acceptance.
Invitation alone preserves current handler and execution.
Unauthorized, disabled/missing/stale/commit-time invalid target cannot partially enroll; participation/handoff/event/notification effects use one transaction.
Original-key replay leaves one handoff/outcome/notification; former handler old POST is 403 and original operation GET recovers without new mutation.
Invitation/assignment does not grant personal runtime; actual owner separately consents per issue.

recommendations.criterion: 离线的外部参与者登录后在个人工作台看到派单、转交、补充请求/交回、提交验收、邀请、新评论及 AI 完成/失败/停止已确认的通知，可经账号工作台打开本单；操作者本人不收自己动作的通知。已读/归档不改变待办或权限；被移除者只收不含本单内容的移除通知，之后不能经旧通知打开本单。同为来源成员的参与者不在来源 inbox 重复收到；外部参与者不在来源空间产生 inbox 或订阅记录。通知投递失败不影响业务操作，重放不重复通知。

clauses.clause: Offline invitation/transfer/new-comment notices, real fresh login and exact account comment anchor.
Bounded self-notice avoidance, read/archive independence and content-free removed notice/old-link refusal.
Every information/acceptance/proven AI lifecycle notification is available after offline login in both actual clients.
Full source-member inbox dedup, external source inbox/subscriber isolation and post-commit delivery-failure/replay fanout.
clauses.scope: Bounded service isolation and persisted-notification rollback/proof replay are supplemental support; they do not establish full offline fanout or external delivery failure semantics.

remaining_gaps: Full source-inbox/subscriber isolation/dedup and post-commit delivery-failure fanout.

provenance.configuration_hash_scope: Retained safe runtime ID/public password/admin/managed configuration matching; no private credentials or configuration values recomputed.

retained_attempts.reason: Both real clients reached comment setup and failed 400. Fixture sent workflow-only expected_collaboration_revision; corrected accepted comment fields, without product/assertion relaxation.

retained_attempts.classification: earlier-source pass; not substituted for final run3/current rerun

commit_dependency.root_explicit_ownership: Root explicitly took ownership of including the existing helper unchanged in the offline Lore slice.
commit_dependency.fixtures_ts_note: HEAD password/login/register/getToken/requestJSON helpers suffice. Dirty countIssueDispatches row guard is never used by this flow.
commit_dependency.account_path_note: Only administration route support differs; offline view/issue/comment account paths are already supported at HEAD.

helper_review.loopback: Offline fixture/spec validate API, database, Web and renderer loopback; tracked native harness validates API/WS/renderer loopback and cancels non-loopback network traffic.
helper_review.credentials: Fresh public login JWT stays inside fixture closure and private isolated profile; environment passes task-owned settings. No credentials/cookies enter attached evidence.
helper_review.profiles: Each native open creates a new profile. All contexts/apps are owned in Sets; close deletes live handles; finally closes any remaining app/context then removes own mkdtemp profiles. firstWindow error also closes launched app.
helper_review.errors_and_headers: pageerror arrays must be empty; native errors/header predicates and zero daemonStarts are asserted at each close.
helper_review.routes: Uses actual tracked Main routing/IPC functions and built preload/renderer. This is not installed full Main startup.
helper_review.screenshot_helpers: nativeScreenshot/captureNativeSection compile and lint here but are not invoked by offline assertions. Their geometry/zoom behavior retains separate existing evidence; no new screenshot acceptance is inferred.

commit_dependency.remaining_limitation: Full clean-HEAD product build/journey is not executed by this reviewer; current production source is shared dirty implementation. Root owns staging and final commit verification.

findings_not_fixed.issue: Six required lifecycle/proven AI notification kinds are absent from the dual-client offline assertions.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Keep AC83 pending; extend exact notification kind/identity/link and current proof evidence.

findings_not_fixed.issue: Source inbox/subscriber isolation is bounded; notification-write rollback and concurrent proof replay do not prove post-commit external delivery failure leaves the business operation successful.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Keep AC83 partial and retain exact storage failure versus external delivery distinction.
